Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 22 Records detected"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (dates 2026-01-30, 2025-11-01, 2025-08-02, 2025-07-25, 2025-07-22), all with India as DESTINATION and UK as ORIGIN. Zero rows with India as origin/destination abroad. Slug variants tried: robin-chemicals-private-limited (22 records, imports only), robin-chemicals-pvt-ltd (no records), robin-chemicals (no records).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic sales split could be retrieved. Search tooling was unavailable during this check (web_search returned connection errors), and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record seen; this is an absence of retrievable evidence, not a confirmed absence of domestic business.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the declared HS 210690 (food preparations) does not match the observed trade activity. All 5 visible customs rows are imports of lime oil (essential oil) under HS 33011990 from UK suppliers R.C.TREATT & CO LTD, UNGERER LIMITED and R C TREATT AND CO LIMITED, consigned to Chennai Sea port. The company appears to be an IMPORTER of flavour/fragrance raw materials, not an exporter of food products. No export bill-of-lading, no export date, no outbound destination was found — следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено. Domestic supply evidence also not found in accessible sources. Per project rules this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the database, HS code should be corrected to the factual 33011990 (essential oils) with the import direction noted, and the declared 210690 flagged as unverified. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in accessible sources, not estimated. Note also that the ImportKey 'Buyers' block lists ROBIN CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED as a supplier to PACIFIC REFRESHMENTS PTE. LTD. (Singapore) — this is a platform aggregation artefact with no dated B/L row behind it, so it is treated as declared, not confirmed.
